Website Support & Maintenance

Website Maintenance Plans That Keep Your Website Running Smoothly

Your website needs regular attention to remain secure, functional, and up to date. Our website maintenance plans provide ongoing support for businesses that need help managing updates, fixing technical issues, monitoring website performance, and keeping their website working properly.

Whether you have a WordPress website, business website, e-commerce store, or another type of website, we offer flexible website maintenance packages based on your website’s requirements and support needs.

Monthly Support | Website Updates | Security Checks | Technical Assistance

Get a Free Website Maintenance Consultation

Monthly Support

Ongoing help when your website needs attention

Website Updates

Keep plugins, themes, and website components updated

Technical Fixes

Help with errors, broken features, and website issues

Flexible Plans

Choose support based on your website and requirements

Book a Free Consultation

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

What Is Included in Website Maintenance?

A website can develop problems over time due to outdated software, plugin conflicts, hosting changes, security concerns, broken features, and other technical issues. Regular monthly website maintenance helps identify and address these issues before they become larger problems.

Depending on your website and selected plan, our maintenance services may include:

  • WordPress core updates
  • Plugin and theme updates
  • Website security checks
  • Broken link and error monitoring
  • Website backups
  • Speed and performance review
  • Mobile responsiveness checks
  • Content and image updates
  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Database maintenance
  • Basic SEO issue monitoring
  • Website support and consultation

Our goal is simple: help you spend less time dealing with website problems and more time running your business.

How We Work

Our process is clear, efficient, and built around your needs

01

Free Consultation

We start by reviewing your site and identifying the problems — whether it’s SEO, loading speed, DNS errors, or broken features.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Fast Repairs

Most issues are resolved within 1–3 business days. We fix, test, and verify every change for full functionality.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

Website Maintenance for WordPress and Business Websites

WordPress websites require regular updates and monitoring. Plugins, themes, and the WordPress core can change over time, and updates may occasionally create compatibility issues.

Our WordPress maintenance plans can help manage routine updates while providing technical support when something goes wrong. Before making significant changes, we review the website and take appropriate precautions to reduce the risk of disruption.

We also provide website support plans for businesses using other platforms and custom-built websites. If your website requires ongoing technical assistance, we can discuss a maintenance arrangement based on its platform, functionality, and expected support requirements.

Why Choose a Monthly Website Maintenance Plan?

Waiting until something breaks can lead to unexpected downtime, emergency repair costs, and lost business opportunities. A regular maintenance plan gives you a point of contact for ongoing website care.

With our website care plans, you can receive help with routine maintenance, updates, technical monitoring, and smaller website changes without having to search for a developer every time an issue appears.

Our Maintenance Support Can Help With:

  • Keeping website software updated
  • Identifying common technical problems
  • Fixing minor website errors
  • Monitoring important website functions
  • Updating content when included in your plan
  • Maintaining backups
  • Providing technical support when needed
  • Reviewing website performance over time

Need Help Maintaining Your Website?

Tell us what platform your website uses and what type of support you need. We can recommend a suitable website maintenance package based on your requirements.

What Affects Website Maintenance Cost?

Website maintenance cost depends on the amount of work required to keep your website running properly. A simple five-page business website usually requires less maintenance than a large e-commerce website with frequent orders, integrations, and software updates.

Pricing may depend on:

  • Website platform and technology
  • Number of pages
  • Plugins and third-party integrations
  • E-commerce or booking functionality
  • Frequency of updates
  • Security requirements
  • Content update requirements
  • Website traffic and hosting setup
  • Level of technical support needed

We review your website before recommending a plan so you understand the expected scope and website maintenance pricing.

Not Sure Which Plan You Need?

We can review your website and discuss the level of ongoing support required. If you only need occasional help, you may not need a full monthly plan.

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Pay only after the work is done
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

Quick and hassle-free from the first call

Getting your WordPress website repaired is quick and hassle-free. Simply call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your contact information — and we’ll get back to you promptly.

Once we connect, we’ll schedule a live website review with you, either by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet (whichever works best). During this session, we’ll:

  • Review your website in real-time

  • Identify and explain the issues you’re facing

  • Provide a clear solution and expected timeline

  • Begin work immediately — after taking a full backup of your current website

We prioritize secure and transparent repairs, ensuring your website data and functionality are fully protected throughout the process. As a trusted USA-based website repair service, we understand how important your site is to your business — and we treat every repair with the urgency and care it deserves.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Maintenance Plans

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
What is included in a website maintenance plan?

Our website maintenance plans can include website updates, backups, security checks, error monitoring, technical troubleshooting, performance reviews, and content updates. The exact services depend on your selected plan and website requirements.

How much does website maintenance cost?

Website maintenance cost varies based on your website’s size, platform, functionality, and required level of support. Basic plans may start from $300 per month, while larger or more complex websites may require a customized maintenance package.

Do you offer WordPress maintenance plans?

Yes. Our WordPress maintenance plans can include WordPress core updates, plugin and theme updates, backups, security checks, error monitoring, and technical support.

Can you maintain a website that you did not build?

Yes. In many cases, we can provide maintenance and support for an existing website even if it was built by another developer or company. We first review the website, platform, and current condition to determine the required support.

What happens if my website has a major technical problem?

If a significant issue occurs, we can diagnose the problem and determine whether it is covered by your maintenance plan. Work outside the agreed maintenance scope, such as major development, extensive malware recovery, or complex website repair, may require a separate quote.

Can I pay per fix instead of a monthly plan?

Yes. If you only need one problem repaired, we offer per-issue pricing with speedy and standard turnaround options. See our website repair pricing.

Do you need a deposit to start a maintenance plan?

No deposit is required for repairs, and we review your website first so you get a clear plan and quote before anything starts.

Website Maintenance Packages and Pricing

We offer flexible website maintenance packages based on your website platform, size, functionality, and the level of support you need. If your website requires frequent updates or has complex features, we can recommend a plan that fits your requirements.

Starter Website Maintenance

For small business websites that need routine support

A practical option for websites that need regular updates, monitoring, and occasional technical assistance.

May include:

  • WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates
  • Basic security checks
  • Regular website backups
  • Broken link and error checks
  • Basic performance monitoring
  • Minor content updates
  • Technical support for common issues

Starting from $300/month

Business Website Maintenance

For growing websites that need more regular support

This plan is suitable for businesses with multiple pages, active website features, or more frequent update requirements.

May include:

  • Everything in the Starter plan
  • More frequent website monitoring
  • Website speed and performance checks
  • Security and vulnerability review
  • Additional content or image updates
  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Database and website health checks
  • Basic SEO issue monitoring
  • Priority maintenance support

Starting from $500/month

Advanced Website Care Plan

For e-commerce, high-traffic, and complex websites

Larger websites often require more hands-on monitoring and technical support. This plan can be customized for websites with advanced functionality, booking systems, online stores, membership areas, or custom features.

Support may include:

  • Advanced website monitoring
  • Frequent backups and update management
  • Security monitoring and issue response
  • Performance and speed reviews
  • Plugin and compatibility troubleshooting
  • Database maintenance
  • E-commerce or functionality checks
  • Technical issue diagnosis
  • Ongoing developer support

Custom pricing based on website requirements

What We Check and Maintain

Our website maintenance plans are designed to cover the routine tasks that help keep your website secure, functional, and accessible.

Website Updates

We review and manage applicable updates for your website, including WordPress core, themes, plugins, and other supported components. Updates are handled carefully to reduce the risk of compatibility problems.

Security and Website Health

We check for common security and website health issues that may affect your site. Depending on your plan, this can include vulnerability checks, suspicious activity review, access issues, and general security monitoring.

Backups

Regular backups help protect important website files and data. Backup frequency depends on your selected maintenance plan and the type of website you operate.

Broken Pages and Technical Errors

We help identify issues such as broken pages, missing content, plugin conflicts, error messages, and other technical problems that affect website functionality.

Speed and Performance

A slow website can create a poor visitor experience. We review relevant performance issues and can address problems related to website configuration, unnecessary files, plugins, and other technical factors where applicable.

Content and Website Changes

Need to update business hours, contact information, services, images, or other website content? Maintenance support can include routine changes based on your selected website support plan.

Website Maintenance Without the Stress of Handling It Yourself

Managing updates, backups, security checks, and technical issues can take time away from your business. With ongoing monthly website maintenance, you have a technical team available to help keep your website maintained.

Instead of waiting for a broken page, failed update, or unexpected error, you can have regular website care based on an agreed support plan.

We work with small business websites, WordPress websites, corporate sites, e-commerce platforms, and websites with custom functionality.

We Can Help Maintain:

  • Small business websites
  • WordPress websites
  • E-commerce websites
  • Corporate websites
  • Service business websites
  • Portfolio and informational websites
  • Membership and booking websites
  • Custom-built websites

Need Ongoing Website Support?

Whether you need routine updates or a more comprehensive maintenance arrangement, we can discuss the right level of support for your website.

Tell us about your website, and we will help you understand which maintenance plan makes sense for your needs.

WordPress Maintenance Packages

Most of the sites we maintain run on WordPress, Elementor or Divi. Our WordPress maintenance packages cover core, theme and plugin updates, security scans and hardening, backups and restore points, speed and uptime monitoring, and SEO upkeep, so small problems are caught before they turn into broken pages or lost rankings.

Need a one-time fix instead of a monthly plan?

If you only need a specific problem repaired, you can pay per issue. See our website repair pricing for fixed per-fix prices and turnaround times. There is no deposit, and you pay after the work is done.

Get a Website Maintenance Plan That Fits Your Needs

Tell us about your website and the type of support you need. We can review your requirements and recommend a suitable website maintenance package with clear pricing and no unnecessary services.

Let's Have A Free Consultation

Call or text us — we’ll review your website live and give you a clear plan and a free, no-obligation quote.

(832) 266 7209 — Call Now
Request Online Consultation
